Name: deptree
Description: Analyze the dependency tree of a file (Makefile, Python source, Python packages)

Subcommands.Name: dirty
Subcommands.AppliesTo: System.FileName:Makefile OR System.FileExtension:.mk OR System.FileExtension:.mak OR System.FileExtension:.make

Subcommands.Name: pkg-text
Subcommands.AppliesTo: System.FileName:requirements.txt OR System.FileName:pyproject.toml OR System.FileName:setup.cfg OR System.FileName:Pipfile OR System.FileName:setup.py

Mcp.Description: Analyze the dependency tree of a file. Supports Makefile build dependencies, Python source import dependencies, Python installed package dependencies, and Python function call graphs (code2flow + pyan3 + ast). Read-only, no side effects.

path.description: Absolute path to a Makefile, .py file, requirements.txt, or pyproject.toml

mode.description: Analysis mode. auto = detect by file extension

package_name.description: Package mode: specific package to analyze (omit for all packages)

reverse.description: Package mode: reverse dependency (who depends on this package)

python.description: Path to Python executable (default: auto-detect project venv)

no_stdlib.description: Source mode: hide standard library nodes

root.description: CallGraph mode: entry function name (default: auto-detect main or first function)

no_code2flow.description: CallGraph mode: disable code2flow backend (fallback to pyan3/ast)
